events.speaker: customer
events.text: The refrigerator is in the pantry, and it is leaking water right now.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I misspoke: it is a wine cooler, not a refrigerator. Friday morning works best, I need a quote before repairs, my maximum for this repair is four hundred U.S. dollars, and the one hundred U.S. dollar dispatch fee is separate.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Correction: Thursday afternoon works better than Friday morning. The leak has stopped; there is no water leaking now.
